rules: Freeze all s11 and 469 OOF predictions
On 2022 only, remove the intercept and s11-logit projection from the 469-vs-s11 logit difference
Fit one nonnegative rank-residual weight on 2022 with both target classes constrained non-worse
Apply the frozen projection and weight unchanged to 2023 and 2024
Do not use evaluation-year targets for fitting and do not access Test
